tasks.title: Version the engine-neutral combat IR
tasks.done_when: A versioned schema rejects absolute Elden Ring damage, validates provenance and units, and has synthetic golden fixtures.

tasks.title: Record and replay deterministic combat traces
tasks.done_when: The same synthetic input/world trace produces byte-stable action and contact events across repeated runs.

tasks.title: Make Skyrim authoritative for stamina
tasks.done_when: The core schedules and reports costs while Skyrim owns the pool, maximum, regeneration, and save state; ABI and synthetic tests cover exhaustion.

tasks.title: Route root-motion intent through Skyrim collision
tasks.done_when: A narrow adapter applies bounded movement requests through the character controller without teleporting and reports actual position next tick.

tasks.title: Arbitrate incoming dodge, block, and hurt results
tasks.done_when: Incoming native hits are classified once as dodged, jumped, blocked, guard-broken, or landed without duplicating Skyrim damage.

tasks.title: Emit deterministic runtime event logs
tasks.done_when: Action, movement, contact, confirmation, stamina, and consequence events have stable identifiers and replay-comparable serialization.

tasks.title: Apply hit-stop without freezing unrelated Skyrim systems
tasks.done_when: Confirmed hits produce bounded attacker/target hit-stop intent with deterministic overlap rules and no global time freeze.

tasks.title: Expose the shared consequence contract through the ABI
tasks.done_when: Melee, spell, throwable, hazard, and creature delivery can submit one ABI-stable consequence payload without absolute source-game damage.

tasks.title: Bridge separate poise and stance state to actors
tasks.done_when: Defensive poise interruption and offensive stance accumulation remain independent through actor lifecycle and serialization adapters.

tasks.title: Add remappable gamepad bindings
tasks.done_when: Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad produce the same edge semantics without double-firing Skyrim handlers.

tasks.title: Automate exact-commit runtime evidence capture
tasks.done_when: A tool fingerprints DLLs, logs, commit, runtime versions, hardware, and explicit acceptance assertions without committing evidence.

tasks.title: Validate real extracted actions against the IR
tasks.done_when: Owner-generated timings, motion, sweeps, stamina, and provenance validate and are fingerprinted under the source profile.

tasks.title: Validate owner-generated animation retargeting
tasks.done_when: Converted owner animations match IR windows within one frame and pass skeleton/root-motion validation in Skyrim.

tasks.title: Prove the colossal-sword slice under CrossOver
tasks.done_when: Every release acceptance assertion passes on the M2 Pro against artifacts and owner data fingerprinted to the exact commit.
